nextStep.ghost.aria: Press Tab or → to accept this suggestion
nextStep.error.stale: This suggestion is out of date; use the newest one
nextStep.error.missing: That suggestion is no longer available
nextStep.settings.title: Next-step suggestions
nextStep.settings.desc: Judges whether a turn is worth continuing; when it is, adds a status summary, a question and 1–2 concrete next steps (one extra model call).
nextStep.settings.stats: Generated {generated} ({hidden} hidden) · failed {failed} · aborted {aborted} · skipped {skipped} · in flight {inflight}
nextStep.settings.offHint: While off, no request is made; cards already in the conversation stay.
nextStep.settings.generateHint: When no card appears, a “Generate a next-step card” button shows under the latest answer.
nextStep.error.budget: This session has used up its card budget
nextStep.error.exists: This turn already has a card
nextStep.error.inflight: Already generating; try again in a moment
nextStep.error.noTurn: No completed turn to generate a card for
nextStep.settings.tier.mustHint: Only when it is clearly needed
nextStep.settings.tier.couldHint: Also when it is a plausible next step (default)
nextStep.settings.tier.anyHint: Every turn, even when judged unnecessary (experimental)
nextStep.settings.telemetryHint: Local file only, never your message text
nextStep.settings.reviewInsufficient: Not enough data ({turns} turns / {shown} cards); keep going
nextStep.error.hidden: This suggestion is not shown right now
